summary: Frontend-only testing for Iceland itinerary page, Day-based itinerary tabs on Iceland/Venice/Italy, Egypt regression, Tour summary table, and homepage TrustBar. 95% of acceptance criteria pass. One mobile TrustBar bug surfaced: the 'years of trust' slide is never shown on <400px screens because TrustBar locks to SLIDES[0] (ratings) when !wide, so the requirement '31 years of trust (without Over) on small screens' is not met.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (<400px) the carousel is locked to SLIDES[0] 'ratings' (see useWide + `slide = wide ? SLIDES[i] : SLIDES[0]`), so trust-slide-years ('31 years of trust') is never rendered on small screens. The 'Over ' span is correctly hidden by `hidden sm:inline` but the slide itself never surfaces on mobile. Acceptance says 390px should show '31 years of trust' (without 'Over').

action_items: Fix TrustBar.jsx so the 'heritage' slide (with trust-slide-years) also appears on <400px screens. Either allow rotation across all slides on mobile too, or render SLIDES as a cycling sequence regardless of `wide`. The existing `hidden sm:inline` on the 'Over ' prefix already handles the <640px copy requirement, so just stop short-circuiting to SLIDES[0].
critical_code_review_comments: TrustBar: `wide ? SLIDES[i] : SLIDES[0]` conflicts with the product requirement that the years-of-trust message appears on small screens. Rotation should not be gated by viewport.

EgyptRoute tabs expose two data-testids per tab (`eg-route-tab-N` and `eg-route-tab-city-N`). The 'city' child shares the `eg-route-tab-` prefix, which breaks naive `[data-testid^="eg-route-tab-"]` selectors (returns 2x tab count). Prefer a disjoint prefix like `eg-route-tab-city` → `eg-route-city-N` to avoid tester ambiguity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iceland page (/europa/iceland-glaciers-northern-lights): title/hero/price/count-up OK (₹2,02,130 strike, SAVE 5%, ₹1,92,024 from). 7 Day tabs (eg-route-tab-0..6) with Reykjavík for 1-3 and Akureyri for 4-7. Clicking tab-4 scrolls section-4 which shows 'Day 5 · Akureyri' + 'The Diamond Circle' h3 + 2 activity cards. Section 0 shows Hotel Reykjavík Grand — 3 nights and has 2 'Optional' activities (total 3 'Optional' token hits incl header). Section 3 shows Hotel Kjarnalundur. Desktop gallery height=300px, mobile gallery height=220px (mobile regression fixed). Venice page: 8 day tabs (Venice 1-3, Vienna 4-8), S1 Noventa, S2 Grand Canal gondola + Murano, S5 Schönbrunn, S6 Bratislava, tab-6 click selects correctly. 'View more' toggles exist inside activity cards (expected, not day bullet toggles). Italy page: 7 tabs (Rome 1-3, Florence 4-7), h3s correct (Arrival in Rome, Rome highlights, Travel to Florence, Florence highlights, Florence – departure), Hotel Artemide only on sec0, Hotel Spadai only on sec3. Egypt native page: 5 tabs with Day ranges (Day 1–4 Cairo, Day 4–7 Nile Cruise, Day 7 Luxor, Day 7–10 Hurghada, Day 10–11 Cairo), 5 sections, 5 galleries, no console errors. Tour summary CTA → #summary shows table [data-testid=eg-glance-table] with 7 data rows (8 incl header) and 14 photos naturalWidth>0. TrustBar desktop (1920): slide rotates to show 'Over 31 years of trust'. TrustBar mobile (390): data-testid trust-slide-years NEVER appears in DOM — TrustBar uses `wide ? SLIDES[i] : SLIDES[0]` locking mobile to ratings slide only. Zero console errors on any tested page.
rca of the issue: TrustBar.jsx line 77: `const slide = wide ? SLIDES[i] : SLIDES[0];` combined with line 71 `if (paused || !wide) return undefined;` means on <400px the slide index never advances and only SLIDES[0] ('ratings') is rendered. Hence the 'heritage' slide containing trust-slide-years never mounts. Fix: cycle slides on all widths; the `hidden sm:inline` on the 'Over ' span already handles the small-screen copy variant.
